state.contract: Portia 0.10.0 wraps Fitz4 native queue TTL, delay and NACK. Fitz owns retries and DLQ; accepted queue publication remains best effort, not a durable business completion guarantee. Failed processing is incomplete. Unknown transport outcomes must not trigger a second disposition. System operator roles must belong to an authenticated identity. Review only supplied source, and express uncertainty where it is insufficient.
state.provider_facts: NackAsync requires negotiated capability and a current live reservation token. Unsupported capability throws NotSupportedException before sending. Queue attempt metadata remains unavailable in native Fitz4 deliveries. Native RpcWorkerRegistration.UnregisterAsync serializes concurrent withdrawal and retains its retryable state after a failure.

unsupported_publication_cannot_drop_opti.instructions: Does the default publisher reject nondefault delay or TTL instead of silently enqueueing without those controls?

native_options_preserve_envelope.instructions: Does the Fitz publisher forward the publication controls to native EnqueueWithOptionsAsync while preserving the same envelope, credentials and explicit request metadata?

legacy_publication_preserved.instructions: Does existing EnqueueAsync keep using the legacy native enqueue path without adding per-message TTL?

invalid_queue_options_rejected.instructions: Are negative or fractional-second publication/retry delays and zero publication TTL rejected before transmitting or processing work?

native_retry_no_republication.instructions: Does native retry relinquish the existing reservation using NackAsync, without acknowledging or republishing the request?

renewal_stopped_before_settlement.instructions: Do native ACK and NACK both await stopped renewal before starting the token operation?

lost_reservation_cannot_nack.instructions: Does the native consumer prevent NACK after cancellation of reservation ownership or a failed renewal?

unknown_ack_cannot_be_nacked.instructions: Does a started acknowledgment prevent later NACK even when the acknowledgment response failed?

failed_disposition_not_repeated.instructions: Does the runner avoid invoking a second disposition after an acknowledgment or retry release has already started and failed?

unsupported_explicit_retry_cannot_degrad.instructions: Is NotSupportedException swallowed only for default abandonment while an explicitly selected retry delay fails?

no_fabricated_attempts.instructions: Does the consumer continue to expose the transport attempt rather than inventing a Portia-owned retry count?

unauthenticated_role_cannot_elevate.instructions: Does the shared operator guard require the configured role on an authenticated identity, so a role only on a separate unauthenticated identity cannot elevate an ordinary authenticated user?

final_withdrawal_budget_is_shared.instructions: Does registrar final disposal use one overall timeout budget across retained registrations instead of a fresh five seconds per endpoint?
